rules.statement: A sub-tenant in occupation of premises under a contract of sub-tenancy entered into before an action for ejectment has commenced against the tenant is not bound by the decree in such an action unless he was joined as a party to the proceedings.
rules.supporting_quote: "a sub-tenant in occupation of premises under a contract of sub-tenancy entered into before an action for ejectment has commenced against the tenant is not bound by the-decree in such an action unless he was joined as a party to the-proceedings"
